scripts.build: mkdir -p generated/docs-site generated/dist && redocly build-docs --config contracts/internal-api/redocly.yaml contracts/internal-api/openapi.yaml --output generated/docs-site/index.html && node scripts/inject-mermaid.js generated/docs-site/index.html
scripts.bundle: mkdir -p generated/dist && redocly bundle --config contracts/internal-api/redocly.yaml contracts/internal-api/openapi.yaml --output generated/dist/openapi-bundled.yaml && redocly bundle --config contracts/internal-api/redocly.yaml contracts/internal-api/openapi.yaml --output generated/dist/openapi-bundled.json
